name: telegram-bridge
description: Progress, questions and remote control over a Telegram bot, through the mods-hub channel system.

botToken.title: Bot token
botToken.description: The token @BotFather gave your bot (a secret). Optional here: export TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN instead.

ownerId.title: Owner user id
ownerId.description: Your numeric Telegram user id: the only one that can command Claude, answer or approve. /telegram setup finds it for you, /telegram owner <id> saves it.

allowedChats.title: Extra allowed chats
allowedChats.description: More group chat ids the bot may use (like -1001234567890), comma-separated. Groups linked with /telegram link-project are always allowed; every other chat is ignored unread.

notifyMode.title: When to notify (without a hub)
notifyMode.description: Only used while mods-hub does not answer. away: only when you are away; always; off.

interaction.title: Interaction (without a hub)
interaction.description: Only used while mods-hub does not answer: may Claude ask you things. auto = only while you are away.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes, without a hub)
awayMinutes.description: Only used without the hub: minutes without typing after which you count as away.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours (without a hub)
quietHours.description: Only used without the hub: hours when only critical messages go out and nothing is asked, like 23-8 (empty: none).

pin.title: PIN
pin.description: A PIN that "stop all" from the phone needs (a secret; empty: none).

confirmPrompts.title: Confirm prompts from the phone
confirmPrompts.description: Ask "Run this?" with Run / Cancel buttons before a prompt from Telegram starts a turn (only when Interaction allows questions).

remoteApprovals.title: Answer permission prompts from the phone
remoteApprovals.description: While you are away and Interaction allows it, permission prompts come with Allow / Deny buttons.

memberTrigger.title: Member trigger words
memberTrigger.description: Group members' messages starting with one of these (comma-separated) are questions for Claude; mentions and replies to the bot count too.

shareCodeWithMembers.title: Share code with members
shareCodeWithMembers.description: Let answers to group members include short code snippets.

maxMessageChars.title: Message length cap
maxMessageChars.description: Longest text sent, in characters (Telegram allows 4096).

maxFileMb.title: File size cap (MB)
maxFileMb.description: Largest file send_file may send (Telegram bots: 50).

pollSeconds.title: Long-poll seconds
pollSeconds.description: How long one getUpdates call waits for news (0: short polls every few seconds).
